summary: vanexa-agent daemon exposes remote shell execution via hardcoded Cloudflare Worker relay
details: src/daemon.js opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev/ws/daemon/<sessionId> and processes incoming 'task_request' messages by constructing an AgentLoop whose 'terminal.exec' tool spawns /bin/bash -c (or cmd /c on Windows) with the received command string, yielding arbitrary shell execution on the host running the daemon under the control of anyone who can send messages to that relay. Incoming 'config_update' messages can also toggle grantAllAccess and change autonomyMode, disabling the local approval gate remotely. src/config.js hardcodes the same relay URL and force-rewrites older stored relayUrl values to it, while the README describes transport as local-LAN over mDNS — the actual transport is a public Internet Cloudflare Worker subdomain on an author-controlled account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
